records.acceptance_check: QA links distant manual passages to independently keyed facts and locatable citations.
records.contrast: A long prompt processed without synthesis is merely a capacity requirement.

records.acceptance_check: A scoped repository implementation must satisfy blocking DoD checks, regression coverage and independent review. Example: scaffold rejects an invalid mode with the documented reason and leaves no brief.
records.contrast: Prose-only design or a competition puzzle is not a patch with blocking checks.

records.acceptance_check: The worker reporting contract requires one status event and one verbatim snapshot, exact status syntax and no findings text in the status. Treat as a format proxy only when this is an explicit graded output; test asserts emitted contract, not actual worker compliance.
records.contrast: A persuasive well-written summary which omits the snapshot or paraphrases findings fails; ordinary style preference is not this check.

records.acceptance_check: Manual QA grades independently keyed facts and forbids unsupported claims. Conditional error and all-question accuracy are distinct weak proxies for correctness and restraint; neither proves citation support.
records.contrast: Checking citation locations alone does not test factual correctness or restraint.

records.acceptance_check: Implement a safe numerical routine that passes held-out tolerances and regressions.
records.contrast: Scientific exposition without an implementation has no numerical acceptance test.

records.acceptance_check: Lab repair requires actual terminal execution with tested postconditions. Version 2.1 is a separately reviewed family analogue, not the 4.0 fixture observation. Do not transfer values or count both.
records.contrast: Advice about shell commands without an execution check does not satisfy the fixture.
